title: Two professions per player
changes: Players can now pursue two professions at the same time.
Profession changes are available once every 24 hours and reset the profession being abandoned.
The profession panel now uses F9 so it no longer conflicts with TargetPortal's P shortcut.
Resolved confirmed hotkey conflicts affecting boss powers, digging, the compass, Seidr chests, building, comfort visibility, loot pickup, and farming controls.
